purpose_scope: Initial expert-facing valuation-development rubric; FDD/ESG/earnings/board use requires separate purpose-specific primary examples and calibration under the same axes.

execution.mode: future actual native independent workers; role labels alone do not constitute reviews

reasoning_calibration.selection: compare on the same frozen source-backed packets and five-axis contract; record substantive findings, disagreement, stability and resource cost; freeze the user-approved choice and exact config hash

review_input: frozen purpose, intended reader and cutoff
candidate output hash and accessible model/evidence pack
original files plus exact locators and inspected page renders
blinding: hide candidate identity/version label/change intent where feasible, preserving source identity necessary for verification
reviewers issue first judgments without other reviewers scores
candidate author never receives protected evaluation answers
B01-B03 and this review remain exposed development material; do not call them holdout

record_schema.unreviewed_axis: null with reason; never pass or redistributed weight

adjudication.trigger: any pass/fail disagreement, difference greater than one point on any axis, or material finding affecting decision
adjudication.process: independent adjudicator with appropriate task competence (agent or human) examines exact originals/artifacts and records resolution; no automatic averaging

human_reference_labels.use_when_available: additional agreement/error measurements against recorded human judgments; record expertise, provenance, scope and disagreement
human_reference_labels.absence_policy: continue source-anchored independent reviewer calibration; mark human-comparison metrics unavailable and do not claim human-validated grading

approval_boundary.approval_target: exact candidate artifact versions and SHA-256 digests listed in review-bundle-manifest.json
approval_boundary.changes_to_existing_protected_gates: none; preserve all existing protected gates, thresholds and review obligations; assess compatibility in a separately authorised adoption step
approval_boundary.recalibration_trigger: change to rubric, examples, prompt, model/tool setup, case mixture or decision rules
